name: hud_layout
description: Save or restore named HUD widget layout presets. Use when the user says 'save this layout as workshop', 'switch to monitoring mode', 'load my workshop configuration', or 'what layouts do I have?'. Layout names are free-form lowercase strings like 'workshop' or 'monitoring'.

parameters.description: save = store the current widget arrangement under a name. load = restore a saved preset. delete = remove a preset. list = report saved presets.
Preset name, e.g. 'workshop'. Required for save/load/delete.
